verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships as official, modular, tree-shakable ES6 npm packages with TypeScript typings and IntelliSense, plus typedoc API reference and server-side/NullEngine support. A runtime probe confirms @babylonjs/core 9.26.1 is published on npm under Apache-2.0 with about 234K weekly downloads, and community users report that the TypeScript integration works well. Missing for 10: evidenced official SDKs for languages beyond JavaScript/TypeScript (Babylon Native is mentioned only in passing).
